code: log_event <- function(event, user, session_id, value) {   message(sprintf("[appauth] %s user=%s value=%s", event, user, value)) }  server <- function(input, output, session) {   # the connection closes together with the session; the schema is prepared on connect   conn <- aa_session_connection("app.db", prepare = TRUE, settings = settings)    # login, first administrator creation, auto-login, logout   auth <- aa_auth_server("auth", conn, settings, on_event = log_event)    # blocking, deletion, role change and password reset take effect within 30 seconds   aa_session_guard(auth, conn, settings)    # the server part of a tab is attached only for those who have the permission   aa_register_module(auth, "Access", provider, function() {     aa_users_server("users", conn, auth, settings, on_event = log_event)   })    output$main <- renderUI({     req(auth$logged_in())     user <- auth$user()      tabsetPanel(       tabPanel("Tasks",         p("Signed in as ", strong(user$login)),         if (aa_can(user, "Run", provider)) actionButton("run", "Run")       ),       if (aa_can(user, "Access", provider)) tabPanel("Access", aa_users_ui("users")),       tabPanel("Sign out", actionButton("logout", "Sign out"))     )   })    observeEvent(input$run, {     # the permission is checked on the server: a hidden button is not protection     aa_require(auth, "Run", provider, on_event = log_event, settings = settings)     showNotification("Done")   })    observeEvent(input$logout, auth$logout(reload = TRUE)) }
